title: SkyrimNet Leashed
tagline: Add the ability to leash, be leashed, lead, and be lead while leashed.
description:
SkyrimNet (LLM) bridge for Leash Framework.
NPCs can leash and unleash through SkyrimNet actions, and the leashed characters are presented in each prompt.

Requirements:

- Leash Framework: (Nexus 187303) or (Sexlab 50377)

Optional:
- Injury Engine (0.1.0) provide damage narration from falling
author: goodprovider
changelog:
- Leashing a fresh Diary of Mine captive no longer fights DOM's pose (needs SkyrimNet DOM update).
- The leash no longer tries to "unstick" an NPC that DOM is posing, tying, or holding cowering.
- NPCs who are already leashed are not leashed again every few lines.
